description: GitHub-style emoji reaction picker. Persistent bar of reaction chips with counts + a trigger that opens a curated palette popover. Composes pop-over for the palette surface.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Toolbar label (default: data-label-toolbar, then "Reactions"). Also names the palette group.

attributes.name: data-trigger-icon
attributes.description: Text/emoji content of the trigger button (default "😀")

attributes.name: data-label-toolbar
attributes.description: Default toolbar label when no aria-label is authored (default "Reactions")

attributes.name: data-label-dialog
attributes.description: aria-label of the palette dialog (default "Choose a reaction")

attributes.name: data-label-count-one
attributes.description: Count phrase in chip names for the Intl.PluralRules "one" category; {count} is replaced by the Intl.NumberFormat count (default "{count} reaction"). Any CLDR category works: data-label-count-zero, -two, -few, -many.

attributes.name: data-label-count-other
attributes.description: Count phrase for every category without its own data-label-count-* (default "{count} reactions"). Locale comes from the closest [lang].

attributes.name: data-disabled
attributes.description: Read-only mode, observed: chips get aria-disabled and do not toggle, the trigger is disabled and leaves the roving tab order, an open palette closes

events.name: reaction-bar:toggle
events.description: Fires when a chip or palette option is clicked. detail: { reaction, action: 'add'|'remove', count, mine } — count and mine are the values BEFORE the toggle. The chip is then data-pending until setCount() is called for that reaction.

events.name: reaction-bar:palette-open
events.description: Fires when the palette popover opens

events.name: reaction-bar:palette-close
events.description: Fires when the palette popover closes

childAttributes.name: data-reaction
childAttributes.description: Stable identifier sent to the backend (e.g. thumbsup, heart)

childAttributes.name: data-count
childAttributes.description: Current count (≥ 1 to show; 0 removes the chip)

childAttributes.name: data-mine
childAttributes.description: Whether the current user has this reaction (exposed as aria-pressed)

childAttributes.name: data-label
childAttributes.description: Accessible name of the reaction (e.g. "Thumbs up"), on chips and palette buttons; an authored aria-label works too. Falls back to the emoji.

childAttributes.name: data-pending
childAttributes.description: Output: a toggle for this chip is in flight (also aria-busy); further clicks are ignored until setCount()

childAttributes.name: data-palette
childAttributes.description: Marks a <template> child as the available-reactions palette

methods.name: setCount(reaction, count, { mine })
methods.description: Update a chip after the server confirms (call it on failure too, with the old values, to roll back). Clears the pending state, creates the chip from the palette template button (keeping its data-label) if missing, and removes the chip at count 0 — focus moves to a neighbour if the chip had it.

methods.name: openPalette()
methods.description: Open the palette popover (no-op while data-disabled)
